title: The Stars with Rhonda: Mercury Is Furious
description: Rhonda reads the retrograde forecast as serene cosmic fact while the group chat watches, types, and mutes. Ronnie hunts for an upside until his own sign removes him by name.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The stars, with Rhonda. Mercury's in retrograde, so... how bad.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Mercury is not retrograde, Ronnie. Mercury is furious.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Aries. A coupon you saved expires the instant you reach for it. It was never going to scan. The group chat has already seen it.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Taurus. Your reply-all reaches the one person it must never reach. You type three dots. The three dots type back. The group chat is typing.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, the dots typing back is genuinely upsetting.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Cancer. A voicemail from 2019 redelivers at four p.m. You hear yourself make a promise you did not keep. <p:0.3> The group chat has muted you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Muted? Okay, but muted's not gone. <p:0.3> And I'm a Virgo, so please tell me Virgo's the one good one.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Virgo. The chat does not mute you, Ronnie. <p:0.3> It removes you. By name. Mercury holds the door.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Removed me? By name? <p:0.3> Can I at least still see the messages?
